name: Seated Mindful Breathing

instructions.description: Sit comfortably with feet supported and hands resting on your thighs.
Lengthen through the crown of the head while softening the jaw and shoulders.
Bring your attention to the natural rhythm of the breath without trying to force it.
When the mind wanders, gently return focus to the sensation of inhaling and exhaling.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a quiet uninterrupted period for the practice.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Add a simple structure if unguided attention feels difficult.

commentsNotes: Comfort matters more than a perfectly rigid posture.
Keep the breathing easy and quiet.
